Priya: Heads-up team — Customer: PulseMed. They're on a shortened renewal path and low usage on embeddings. Request: a single-day "mini-sprint" to get them from pilot -> steady-state. Prefer compact office hours + a short workshop. Need to confirm time, pre-reqs, and a lightweight feedback capture plan.

Marco: I can do a 120m session Tue 09:00-11:00 CET (includes overlap for APAC later). If we need US-friendly, Wed 16:00-18:00 UTC works. Which timezone is admin leaning toward? :calendar:

Anika: PulseMed prefers EMEA mornings. Tue CET is best. They asked for an ops checklist + sample prompt set.

Drew: I'll own perf + cost quickwins (20m). Can we slot a 10-min renewal signal review and a 5-min feedback pulse at the end?

Priya: Yes — suggested agenda below. Keep it pragmatic and action-oriented so the CSM can use notes in renewal playbook.

Priya: ```
Mini-sprint (120m) - Tue CET
- 05m welcome + goals (CS + PM)
- 15m account health snapshot (usage, errors, costs)
- 25m hands-on: embed & inference walkthrough (Anika)
- 20m migration & Dedicated quick-run (Drew)
- 20m perf tuning clinics: batching, cache, quantization (Marco)
- 10m renewal signals + quick wins (Priya)
- 05m feedback pulse (real-time poll + 1-line ask)
- 20m breakouts / office hours for engineers (optional)
```

Anika: Pre-reqs for attendees: 1) workspace invite 2) API key with test role 3) sample dataset (small CSV) uploaded to their workspace. I'll send a preflight check doc.

Marco: Demo commands I'll use: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"..."}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'` and a snippet for embeddings and batch calls.

Drew: For renewal signals, suggest we capture: active seats, monthly token delta, QoS incidents last 30d, and a simple NPS question in the poll. 

Priya: Feedback capture: short form (3 Qs) + a 30s live emoji reaction at the end. Form link draft: https://forms.redwood.local/pulsemed-postworkshop (Anika will finalize).

CSBot: Scheduling poll created: https://cal.poll/s/pulsemini  Options: Tue 09:00 CET, Wed 16:00 UTC, Thu 08:00 CET. Poll closes in 36h.

Anika: I'll share preflight doc + repo with sample prompts by Mon 12:00 CET: https://drive.redwood.local/pulsemed/preflight-v0.1

Marco: I'll prepare two 1-slide "cost win" snippets showing batching & cache impact: 5-min each.

Drew: Can someone set the recording with captions enabled and auto-upload to the customer drive? Also request 7-day retention given renewal watch.

Priya: Action items: Marco -> slides + code snippets; Anika -> preflight + form; Drew -> demo + postmortem template; Priya -> renewal note template + list of signals to populate. Olivia (CS) will be invited to co-own renewal notes.

Anika: Confirmed attendees so far: 4 engineers, 1 infra lead, 2 product owners. Will update if more.

CSBot: Calendar invite generated and sent to confirmed attendees. Reminder 24h + 1h set.

Priya: Thanks — keeping this tight will help surface blockers before renewal. Ping here with any blockers. :rocket:

Marco: Will do. Quick Q: do we want a dedicated breakout channel during session for logs? Suggest we create `#pulsemed-workshop` ephemeral channel.

Anika: Yes pls. I'll create and invite IRL attendees.

Drew: Great. I'll add synthetic tests to smoke the migration flow before the session.

Priya: Awesome team. Let's reconfirm once poll closes and ensure preflight done.
